title: ROS 2 Quality of Service
keywords: qos best_effort reliable volatile transient_local compatibility publisher subscriber
text: Reliability is request/offered: a reliable publisher can serve best-effort and reliable subscribers; a best-effort publisher cannot serve a reliable subscriber. A transient-local subscriber requires transient-local durability from its publisher. Examine discovered endpoint QoS using ros2 topic info /topic --verbose. Discovery does not prove data delivery.
